questions.question: Is the orientation area clean/well organized and set up with adequate space for people to sit and view the screen comfortably?  (Include picture of orientation area)
Are stickers, wallet cards, T-shirts and other handouts organized and well-stocked to provide material for workers participating in orientation?  (Include pictures of material storage/organization)
Is the Work Rules Acknowledgement QR code printed and available to be scanned by workers at the start of orientation?  (Include picture of printed QR sheets)
